verses.arabic: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
verses.translation: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
verses.transliteration: iq'tarabati l-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa l-qamaru

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٞ مُّسۡتَمِرّٞ
verses.translation: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
verses.transliteration: wa-in yaraw āyatan yuʿ'riḍū wayaqūlū siḥ'run mus'tamirrun

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
verses.translation: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
verses.transliteration: wakadhabū wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum wakullu amrin mus'taqirrun

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
verses.translation: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.
verses.transliteration: walaqad jāahum mina l-anbāi mā fīhi muz'dajarun

verses.arabic: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةٞۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
verses.transliteration: ḥik'matun bālighatun famā tugh'ni l-nudhuru

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ نُّكُرٍ
verses.translation: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
verses.transliteration: fatawalla ʿanhum yawma yadʿu l-dāʿi ilā shayin nukurin

verses.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ
verses.translation: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
verses.transliteration: khushaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi ka-annahum jarādun muntashirun

verses.arabic: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٞ
verses.translation: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
verses.transliteration: muh'ṭiʿīna ilā l-dāʿi yaqūlu l-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasirun

verses.arabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونٞ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
verses.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
verses.transliteration: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnun wa-uz'dujira

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
verses.translation: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
verses.transliteration: fadaʿā rabbahu annī maghlūbun fa-intaṣir

verses.arabic: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٖ مُّنۡهَمِرٖ
verses.translation: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
verses.transliteration: fafataḥnā abwāba l-samāi bimāin mun'hamirin

verses.arabic: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونٗا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
verses.translation: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
verses.transliteration: wafajjarnā l-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqā l-māu ʿalā amrin qad qudira

verses.arabic: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحٖ وَدُسُرٖ
verses.translation: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
verses.transliteration: waḥamalnāhu ʿalā dhāti alwāḥin wadusurin

verses.arabic: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.translation: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
verses.transliteration: tajrī bi-aʿyuninā jazāan liman kāna kufira

verses.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.translation: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
verses.transliteration: walaqad taraknāhā āyatan fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.transliteration: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.transliteration: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.transliteration: kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٖ مُّسۡتَمِرّٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
verses.transliteration: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsin mus'tamirrin

verses.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ
verses.translation: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
verses.transliteration: tanziʿu l-nāsa ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin munqaʿirin

verses.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.transliteration: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.transliteration: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: Thamūd denied the warning.
verses.transliteration: kadhabat thamūdu bil-nudhuri

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٗا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدٗا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.translation: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
verses.transliteration: faqālū abasharan minnā wāḥidan nattabiʿuhu innā idhan lafī ḍalālin wasuʿurin

verses.arabic: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٞ
verses.translation: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
verses.transliteration: a-ul'qiya l-dhik'ru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ashirun

verses.arabic: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدٗا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
verses.translation: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
verses.transliteration: sayaʿlamūna ghadan mani l-kadhābu l-ashiru

verses.arabic: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
verses.translation: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
verses.transliteration: innā mur'silū l-nāqati fit'natan lahum fa-ir'taqib'hum wa-iṣ'ṭabir

verses.arabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ
verses.translation: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
verses.transliteration: wanabbi'hum anna l-māa qis'matun baynahum kullu shir'bin muḥ'taḍarun

verses.arabic: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.translation: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
verses.transliteration: fanādaw ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqara

verses.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.transliteration: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
verses.transliteration: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓiri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.transliteration: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: The people of Lot denied the warning.
verses.transliteration: kadhabat qawmu lūṭin bil-nudhuri

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.
verses.transliteration: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin najjaynāhum bisaḥarin

verses.arabic: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
verses.translation: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
verses.transliteration: niʿ'matan min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakara

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
verses.transliteration: walaqad andharahum baṭshatanā fatamāraw bil-nudhuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
verses.transliteration: walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
verses.translation: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
verses.transliteration: walaqad ṣabbaḥahum buk'ratan ʿadhābun mus'taqirrun

verses.arabic: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: So taste My punishment and warning.
verses.transliteration: fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.transliteration: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
verses.transliteration: walaqad jāa āla fir'ʿawna l-nudhuru

verses.arabic: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
verses.translation: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
verses.transliteration: kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzin muq'tadirin

verses.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
verses.transliteration: akuffārukum khayrun min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī l-zuburi

verses.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ
verses.translation: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
verses.transliteration: am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿun muntaṣirun

verses.arabic: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.translation: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
verses.transliteration: sayuh'zamu l-jamʿu wayuwallūna l-dubura

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.translation: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
verses.transliteration: bali l-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarru

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness..
verses.transliteration: inna l-muj'rimīna fī ḍalālin wasuʿurin

verses.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.translation: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
verses.transliteration: yawma yus'ḥabūna fī l-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqara

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
verses.transliteration: innā kulla shayin khalaqnāhu biqadarin

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
verses.translation: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
verses.transliteration: wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣari

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.translation: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
verses.transliteration: walaqad ahlaknā ashyāʿakum fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: And everything they did is in written records.
verses.transliteration: wakullu shayin faʿalūhu fī l-zuburi

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
verses.translation: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
verses.transliteration: wakullu ṣaghīrin wakabīrin mus'taṭarun

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
verses.transliteration: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaharin

verses.arabic: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
verses.translation: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
verses.transliteration: fī maqʿadi ṣid'qin ʿinda malīkin muq'tadirin
